title: World Markets Spot / Concord Exchange (MegaETH) — no unprivileged extraction path; $668.9k is user custody, $1.10 unattributed
closed_reasons: All user-scoped entry points (batchCommands, newSpotBuy/SellOrder, cancel*, newLendOrder, liquidate, payInterestAndFees, markLendPositionAsNonReturnable, lifoLenderSwap, renewLoan, requestPerpTrueUp, liqSwap) are gated by checkTradingPermission -> CallerIsNotTrader (0xd07a9d6b) for a caller with no account (20/20 probes revert at pinned block 29963541)
Account/custody paths are msg.sender-scoped: withdrawErc20 from a caller with no account -> CallerHasNoAccount (0xfb64298d); allowTradingForAccount(victim) -> CallerNotPermissioned (0xaebf6f28)
All admin paths (setTokenConfig, setOpsAddress, switchTokenAddress) -> AdminRoleOnly (0x10c95c62); changeAdmin reverts for everyone but a separate super-admin
Order-book admin (haltTrading, setMinOrderQuantity) -> ExchangeOnlyCall (0x26e41fb0); order books hold zero tokens
wl* vault admin (setManagerAddress, setTraderAddress, setAdmin, rescueErc20) reverts with vault-specific guards
Order-book compute*MarketOrderSpecify* simulations are callable by anyone but side-effect-free (countBuyOrders unchanged across the call)
No free-credit path: createAccount + depositErc20 credit only actually-transferred tokens; wl* share tokens are tracked under distinct token ids 11/12/13

No liquidatable-keeper profit: 4 accounts are genuinely underwater (users 561/954/1434/1574) but liquidate() reverts LiquidationNotSuccessful (0x62a8087e) — 4/5 spot books and 4/5 perp books have zero orders, so there is no liquidity to execute the liquidation; total sequestered collateral is dust (2.29e9 raw USDm spot/lend, 3.16e7 raw perp)
key_facts: Chain: MegaETH, chain id 4326. Exchange proxy 0x5e3Ae52EbA0F9740364Bd5dd39738e1336086A8b (348-byte dispatcher, internal name 'Concord Exchange').

Facets: router 0xe1fc1881d1c495b399c9890930aa416e89d691c2 (56 selectors); trading 0x431212abc35737011ddd7306fb5229752b6bd115 (22 selectors); bulk/account 0xafba6b6a8d1b8cacd1fc12df9e32f23f1a923417 (26 selectors). Proxy admin EOA 0xCe46EE0664e02d6FF478f08e580De42EeFA29cC9.
14 order books (5 spot bookType 11, 5 perp bookType 22, 4 lend bookType 33) all hold ZERO tokens — single custody contract.

Exchange custody at block 29963541 = $668,908.29 across 9 tokens (USDm 358,475.91; WETH 13.0461; USDT0 432.488; BTC.b 0.28477; wiTRY 10,241,538.32; MEGA 170,090.28; wlBTCb 0.008055; wlUSDm 79.7726; wlETH 0.044902).

Full 1,581 user x 11 token ledger scan at a pinned block: 1,687 active user-token pairs, 1,218 funded users; user-ledger sums equal exchange custody EXACTLY for 8 of 9 tokens; only USDm shows a 1.1e18 raw residual ($1.10).
Therefore $668,907.19 is user-attributable (H-O, self-service) and only $1.10 is unattributed (likely accumulated protocol fees; no admin withdraw function exists -> effectively stuck).

riskAdjustedPortfolioValue scan of all 1,581 users: 4 accounts are UNDERWATER (liquidatable) — users 561/954/1434/1574 with risk-adjusted values -1,211,666 / -14,773 / -5,107,389 / -32,062 in 1e-4 USDm (-$121.17 / -$1.48 / -$510.74 / -$3.21).

Permissionless keeper path is inoperable: an attacker account calling liquidate(userToLiquidate, attackerUid, 0) on all 4 underwater accounts reverts LiquidationNotSuccessful (0x62a8087e) because the order books have no liquidity to execute the liquidation swaps; attacker USDm delta = 0 (fork-proven, test_keeper_liquidation_path).
Custody reconciliation residual is stable across four independent runs: exactly 1.1e18 raw USDm ($1.10) unattributed; all other 8 tokens reconcile to delta 0.
Team publishes a 2026-02-20 collaborative audit (6 High / 12 Medium / 5 Low, all RESOLVED) at github.com/World-Markets-Inc/smart-contract-audits — DefiLlama's audits:0 is wrong.

Contracts are NOT source-verified on Mega Etherscan (chainid 4326) or megaeth.blockscout.com; Sourcify match:null. ABI reconstructed from the team's public interface repo World-Markets-Inc/contract-owner (IConcordProtocolPub, PublicStruct.sol, IConcordProtocolErrors).
Spot order books are effectively empty (countBuyOrders = 0 on 4/5); the DefiLlama 'Spot TVL' is the exchange's user vault balances, not order-book liquidity.
Admin EOA 0xCe46EE0664e02d6FF478f08e580De42EeFA29cC9 can setTokenConfig / setOpsAddress / switchTokenAddress (migrate a token mapping and balances) — $668.9k is exposed to that single EOA key.
caveats: Source is unverified; logic reconstructed from the team's public interfaces + the audit report + deployed-runtime selector extraction. A deeper accounting/funding/liquidation bug cannot be excluded by interface-level probes, though no unprivileged value-moving entry point exists.

Keeper path is state-dependent: if order-book liquidity returns, the 4 underwater accounts (total risk-adjusted deficit ~$641) become liquidatable with a design-intended <=1% keeper bounty. That is a bounded, intended payment, not an extraction.
The three facets were (re)deployed at blocks 21,800,870-876 (2026-06), after the 2026-02-20 audit date.
Point-in-time: all reads at blocks 29,963,373 / 29,963,541 (2026-10-23). Re-read before acting.
The $1.10 residual is inferred to be protocol fees (unattributed by construction, not proven origin).
wl* NAVs computed as getAum()/totalSupply() at the read block.
Read-only: no mainnet transaction signed or sent; all state changes are local forks. No secrets or keyed RPC URLs in the folder (public CI repo).
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live from World Markets Spot on MegaETH: the $668.9k of custody is 100% user-attributable (H-O) and every state-changing entry point is role- or msg.sender-gated (20/20 permissionless probes revert with CallerIsNotTrader / CallerHasNoAccount / AdminRoleOnly / ExchangeOnlyCall; 13/13 fork tests pass); the only residual is $1.10 of unattributed USDm and a single-EOA admin key over the whole vault.
